description:
Render a Studio design or video to files. Spends credits like any
render: a video 25 (platinum 50), a card 10, a set 10 a slide (an App
Store set of 6 is 60), charged once. A card or a set waits for the
render (about a minute) and returns every file in `asset_urls`, slide
1 first; a video returns the run id: poll get_run until it is terminal,
then show the human the file or post it with post_run.

version.description: Version to render. Omit for the current one.

name: studio_export
